learning_outcomes.text: Students recognize conflict and negotiation situations and are able to model them using game theory.
They can determine quantitative and qualitative solutions for such strategic situations using game theory methods, transfer the results to the real situation, and evaluate the solution approaches.

syllabus_topics: Types of games; role of strategy, chance, information and combinatorics
Classic examples of game theory in various applications
Games with complete and incomplete information
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the module examination must be passed. The grade's contribution to the final grade is weighted by credit points.
bibliography: Christian Rieck: Spieltheorie - eine Einführung, Rieck Verlag
Jörg Bewersdorff: Glück, Logik und Bluff: Mathematik im Spiel - Methoden, Ergebnisse und Grenzen, Springer Vieweg
Henry Hamburger: Games as Models of Social Phenomena, Freeman
